player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Countdown numbers game!
Goal: Combine numbers using +, -, *, / to reach the target.
Action format: [i j op] where i,j are indices and op is the operation.
Example: [0 2 *] multiplies number at index 0 with number at index 2.
Division must result in whole numbers only.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid action format. Use `[i j op]` where i,j are indices and op is +,-,*,/
invalid_move.invalid_indices: Invalid indices. Must be different and in range 0-{max_index} Indicators must not fit into the index, so no value is valid for this indicator.
invalid_move.invalid_operation: Adwuma a enni mu (sɛ wɔde zero anaa nea ɛnyɛ integers akatua di dwuma)

outcome.no_moves: Tumi a atwam nyɛ ho. Ka a emu biara: {best_value} (adwenn: {target})
outcome.turn_limit: Nkrataa kɔ so nyɛ ho. Ka a emu biara: {best_value} (adwenn: {target})
